question: Which goddesses are invoked to protect the tips of the hair and the tip of the nose?
premises: The tips of the hair are to be protected by Kamalā.
The tip of the nose is to be protected.
Nara-mohinī is the protecting goddess for the nose tip.
inference: Kamalā protects the hair tips and Nara-mohinī protects the nose tip.
plain_english: May the goddess Kamalā protect the tips of my hair, and Nara-mohinī the tip of my nose.
